assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: {"word":"fever","pos":"n.","meaning":"发烧"}.
Primary request: convey an elevated body temperature from illness, immediately understandable without words.
Scene and subject: a sick child sitting upright under a pale blue blanket, flushed red cheeks and forehead, visible small beads of sweat, tired half-closed eyes. A caregiver beside the child gently presses the back of a hand against the child's forehead to feel its heat, while the child holds an unmarked glass clinical thermometer beside their face with a clearly high red liquid column. The thermometer has no tick marks, digits, letters, or writing. The forehead-touch gesture, flushed sweating face and thermometer together should unmistakably read as fever. Keep the hands away from the temples so this does not resemble headache. No coughing or sneezing.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache and subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper, simple friendly educational illustration, restrained coral, pale blue and muted green palette.
Composition: a single tightly related calm bedside scene centered within the middle 70 percent of a square canvas, generous warm-white negative space, clear at small card size, fully visible subjects and props, soft natural daylight.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, card UI or extra panels. No written symptom labels or symbolic captions. No unrelated objects. This is only the noun sense fever, 发烧.

visualReview.method: actual view_image of persisted fever-source.png; word and meaning absent from art
visualReview.semanticCheck: The flushed, sweating, weary child holds an unmarked thermometer with high red liquid while caregiver checks forehead heat; direct visual evidence conveys fever. Hands do not press temples, distinguishing headache.
visualReview.posAndSenseCheck: noun fever / n. / 发烧, bodily fever rather than enthusiasm
visualReview.styleAndConstraints: Warm-white paper, gouache and pencil appearance, centered single related bedside scene; no letters, numerals, logo or UI visible.
visualReview.optimizedFileCheck: Actual view_image of saved fever.webp at 640x640 passed: caregiver forehead check, red sweaty forehead and unmarked red-column thermometer remain clear.

independentVisualReview.method: Actual view_image inspection of saved optimized image, exact word/POS/meaning and interpretation without target labels; known mapping, not a blind test
independentVisualReview.reason: Actual 640px image shows red sweaty forehead and cheeks, unwell child, thermometer with high red column, and caregiver checking forehead heat. Multiple heat cues express 发烧; no temple-holding or text.

finalReview.method: Agreement of generator actual visual review and independent second viewer; exact sense, source and image hashes checked

Asset type: one square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: {"word":"headache","pos":"n.","meaning":"头痛"}.

The face has normal skin color, no sweating, no flushed cheeks, no thermometer, no blanket, no injury and no bump. The focus is unmistakable head pain, not fever, sleepiness or sadness.

Composition: a single waist-up character with temple-pressing gesture large and centered within the middle 70 percent of a square canvas, generous warm-white negative space, clear at small card size, soft natural daylight.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, card UI or extra panels. No written symptom labels or symbolic captions. No unrelated objects. This is only the noun sense headache, 头痛.
